xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: In FY 2015-16, Revenue Expenditure incurred by the Company but held to be capital in nature by the Assessing Officer (AO) in the assessment orders passed raising a demand of Rs. 23.32 Crs. The issue was decided in favour of the Company by Hon’ble Allahabad High Court in earlier years but Income Tax Department has raised tax demand on same issue in subsequent years and same are pending before CIT(Appeals).
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: No change. The Company expects to get relief from the Appellate Authority and does not anticipate any material adverse financial implication
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Company has received final assessment order dated September 27, 2024 and date of receipt of order is September 30, 2024 for FY 2016-17 raising tax demand of Rs. 70.79 crores on account of certain Transfer Pricing Adjustments.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: No change. The Company expects to get relief from the Appellate Authority and does not anticipate any material adverse financial implication
